purpose: Require immutable competitor identities and versions before publication-grade comparative benchmarks are executed.
rules: Do not use floating labels such as latest, main, master or HEAD as publication pins.
Python competitors must record an exact package version and resolved distribution metadata.
Native competitors must record an immutable commit SHA or release tag plus compiler/build options.
A competitor may be marked ready only after its pinned identity is captured by the benchmark environment manifest.
Hosted CI contract fixtures are not comparative performance measurements.
notes: Pins are intentionally unresolved until the dedicated benchmark environment is chosen. Populate from the exact installed/built versions used for measurements; do not invent or preselect versions merely to satisfy the schema.
